validate_environment: validate the environment has GPU, accelerate, and spqr_quant installed before running SpQR quantized models
update_dtype: update the model dtype to torch.float16 for SpQR quantization and reject any other dtype
process_model_before_weight_loading: process the model by replacing linear layers with SpQR-compatible layers before weight loading
test_is_trainable: test the SpQRHfQuantizer is_trainable property returns False indicating non-trainable quantization
review_is_serializable: review the SpQRHfQuantizer is_serializable method that returns True for saving quantized models
